description: Liste des casernes à Paris et dans les départements de la petite couronne is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ministère de l'intérieur. Mapping of the locations of the brigade of firefighters of Paris (BSPP), 92, 93 and 94. A military unit under the authority of the prefect of police, the brigade of firefighters of Paris fights against fires and provides emergency relief in the capital and the three departments of the small crown (Hauts-de-Seine, Seine-Saint-Denis and Val-de-Marne). Coverage: Ministère de l'intérieur. The portal shows the English title as "List of barracks in Paris and the departments of the small crown" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ministère de l'intérieur. Its keywords include necmergitur. The listing shows 2 download or service links in KML. The listing shows 2016-03-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
